sun.note: Sampled from the official IIMB logo; user-approved.

noon.note: The sun red lifted for use as light on shade (5.6:1 on shade). Fails as a line on stone (2.8:1).

noon-ink.note: Same value as sun by design; the name records its role as light on stone and ground.

error.note: Literal in the CSS, not yet a root custom property.

display-lead.purpose: Homepage H1 only: the institution name, two lines across bays 1 to 7. Fixed 2.3rem at 420px and below.

headline.purpose: Inner-page H1 in the shade page head.

title.purpose: Threshold section heads, the research band title and featured idea, campus band, partner doors.

title-sm.purpose: Story headlines, in-section H3s, research themes subhead.

item.purpose: Fixed item and group heads: route cards, index groups, result groups, empty and success states.

box-head.purpose: Heads of chart, side and citation boxes at normal width.

figure.purpose: Proof numbers; key-fact values, dates and years share weight and width at smaller sizes.

lede.purpose: Section ledes and the homepage positioning line.

small.purpose: Secondary copy, lead facts, key-fact footers, table cells.

label.purpose: Meta, source lines, field labels, tags, captions, prototype strip. Sentence case, at most 0.05em tracking.

shadows.name: menu-panel
shadows.purpose: The only ambient shadow, under an open desktop mega-menu panel; removed at 1320px and below.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The shared easing for every movement and most state changes (--ease).

motion.name: focal-shutters
motion.value: slat-open 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); delay i x 45ms over 6 slats; scaleX 0.5 to 0 from the right
motion.purpose: Once per session: colonnade shutters over the lead photograph, half open at first paint, fully open at about 0.73s.

motion.name: focal-tick-draw
motion.value: draw 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); delay 0.35s; scaleX 0 to 1 from the left
motion.purpose: Once per session: the lead-fact ticks draw in.

motion.name: focal-bay-pulse
motion.value: bay-pulse 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) backwards; delay 0.7s + i x 90ms over 6 bays
motion.purpose: Once per session: one pulse of light grows from the left of each stage rule and releases to the right.

motion.name: threshold-light
motion.purpose: Threshold light bar extends when its head enters view (JS only).

motion.name: route-cards
motion.value: settle 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); delay i x 45ms; opacity 0 and translateY 10px
motion.purpose: Route cards arrive as a list when a stage is chosen.

motion.name: stage-state
motion.value: background and color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); light rule transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

motion.name: menu-panel
motion.value: panel-in 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) clip-path from the top; columns settle 0.32s with delays 0, 0.05s, 0.1s; exit instant
motion.purpose: Mega-menu panels reveal downwards from the masthead.

motion.name: chevron
motion.purpose: Nav chevron when a panel opens.

motion.name: chart-grow
motion.value: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); delay i x 45ms; scaleX 0 to 1 from the left
motion.purpose: Bars grow from the baseline when a chart enters view.

motion.name: chart-light
motion.purpose: A bar lights red on hover or focus.

motion.name: source-reveal
motion.value: opacity and translate 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) via @starting-style from 0 and -4px
motion.purpose: Source lines appear in place when revealed.

motion.name: finder-wash
motion.purpose: Best-fit cells wash in the compare table.

motion.name: finder-advice
motion.purpose: Finder advice settles as it changes.

motion.name: button
motion.value: background, color, border-color 0.2s; arrow translateX 3px 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

motion.name: view-transition
motion.value: old root fade 0.18s ease-in; new root fade and rise 10px 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); view-transition-name masthead on the header
motion.purpose: Cross-document navigation with the masthead held still.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: fade-only 0.15s linear for menu panels and route cards; all other movement removed
motion.purpose: The prefers-reduced-motion path; colour and opacity feedback stays.

brandAssets.name: logo-reversed
brandAssets.purpose: Masthead (54 / 38 / 34px tall) and footer (52px) on shade. Aspect ratio locked.

components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--f-display, "Anek Latin", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 20px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid currentColor; line-height: 1.2; border-radius: 0; transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--sun, #b12322); border-color: var(--sun, #b12322); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--sun-deep, #94191a); border-color: var(--sun-deep, #94191a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--noon-ink, #b12322); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.css: .ds-tl-wrap { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-textlink { font-family: var(--f-display, "Anek Latin", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #1f1c18); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--noon-ink, #b12322); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: .22em; padding: 6px; background: var(--stone, #f4f3f1); } .ds-textlink.ds-on-shade { color: var(--on-shade, #eeeae2); background: var(--shade, #1c1a17); text-decoration-color: var(--noon, #ec6a61); } .ds-textlink:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 3px; } .ds-textlink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--noon-ink, #b12322); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-textlink.ds-on-shade:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--noon, #ec6a61); }

components.css: .ds-mast { font-family: var(--f-display, "Anek Latin", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); background: var(--shade, #1c1a17); color: var(--on-shade, #eeeae2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 76px; padding: 0 24px; } .ds-logo { flex: none; height: 54px; aspect-ratio: 724 / 120; border: 1px dashed rgba(238,234,226,.3); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--on-shade-2, #b9b1a4); } .ds-mast nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-mast a { color: var(--on-shade, #eeeae2); text-decoration: none; padding: 26px 12px 24px; font-size: .98rem; font-weight: 500; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; } .ds-mast a:hover, .ds-mast a[aria-current="page"] { border-bottom-color: var(--noon, #ec6a61); } .ds-mast a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--noon, #ec6a61); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Threshold

Now at IIMB

What is new across the programmes, centres and campus.
components.css: .ds-thr-wrap { font-family: var(--f-display, "Anek Latin", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); background: var(--ground, #e0dfdb); padding: 32px 24px; } .ds-thr { position: relative; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #c6c7c1); padding-top: 22px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5fr 6fr; gap: 14px 24px; align-items: end; color: var(--ink, #1f1c18); } .ds-thr::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -2px; left: 0; height: 3px; width: 8.33%; min-width: 48px; background: var(--noon-ink, #b12322); transform-origin: left; animation: ds-light 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } .ds-thr h2 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 1.25rem + 1.5vw, 2.6rem); font-stretch: 84%; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.012em; } .ds-thr p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2, #5a5349); } @keyframes ds-light { from { transform: scaleX(.25); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-thr::before { animation: none; } }

components.name: Career Stage

components.css: .ds-stages { font-family: var(--f-display, "Anek Latin", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; background: var(--shade, #1c1a17); border-left: 1px solid var(--shade-line, rgba(238,234,226,.11)); } .ds-stage { font: inherit; position: relative; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--shade-line, rgba(238,234,226,.11)); padding: 18px 16px 20px; min-height: 96px; display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; color: var(--on-shade, #eeeae2); cursor: pointer; transition: background .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-stage::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--noon, #ec6a61); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-stage:hover { background: var(--shade-2, #262320); } .ds-stage:hover::before { transform: scaleX(.35); } .ds-stage[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--shade-3, #312d29); } .ds-stage[aria-pressed="true"]::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-stage b { font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-stage span { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--on-shade-2, #b9b1a4); } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--noon, #ec6a61); outline-offset: -3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stage::before { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is walked like B.V. Doshi's 1983 stone campus: long horizontal bands of stone, broken by thresholds of deep corridor shade, with one light, the red of IIMB's sun symbol, falling on whatever is named, current or chosen. Every page is a vertical sequence of full-bleed bands. Shade bands carry the chrome (masthead, page heads, footer) and the story moments (the institution-first lead, research themes, proof, rankings). Courtyard bands of granite-dust ground and lighter reading stone carry facts and reading. The change of material between bands does the sectioning, so there are no cards and no floating containers. The official IIMB logo, reversed for shade, sets the masthead and the footer.

Inside each band a 12-bay colonnade grid governs placement. On inner-page shade heads it shows itself as a short strip of hairline pergola beams. Section heads are thresholds: a hairline across the full width with one bay's width of light laid over its left end. Type is stone-cut: Anek Latin at condensed widths for display and interface, Martel for long reading. Density is high but ordered. Facts sit in hairline-ruled registers with visible source lines, and unknown values appear as dashed amber placeholders instead of being hidden.

Motion has one authored moment and otherwise only answers the visitor. Once per session the lead photograph opens through six colonnade shutters, the fact ticks draw, and a pulse of light travels along the six career-stage bays. Everything else is feedback or continuity, and everything runs from an already-visible default. The world rejects the default institutional homepage (a ranking banner over a carousel above a grid of same-size cards), decorative gradients, shadows as depth, and rounded containers.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed bands of shade, ground and stone; a change of material marks every section.
One accent, the IIMB sun red, used only as light: the primary action, state, focus and rules of light. It is lifted to a lighter red on shade.
Amber exists only to mark the prototype: the banner and unconfirmed-fact placeholders.
The official IIMB lockup, reversed, at a locked aspect ratio in masthead and footer.
A 12-bay colonnade grid, shown as pergola beams on inner-page shade heads.
Condensed stone-cut display type (Anek) paired with a serif reading column (Martel).
Hairline-ruled registers instead of cards; square corners throughout.
One focal motion moment per session; all other motion is feedback or continuity.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: The sun red is light, not colour. It appears only as the primary action, state, focus and rules of light. It is never a background panel, never decoration, and charts are not painted red at rest.

rules.name: The Light Changes With Its Ground Rule
rules.body: On shade the light is the lifted red (noon); on stone and ground it is the brand red (noon-ink). The lifted red fails as a line on light bands (2.8:1 on stone), and the brand red fails as a line on shade (2.6:1), so never swap them.

rules.name: The Amber Is Not Ours Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the prototype, never the institution: the prototype strip and the placeholder. Nothing that would survive into a live site may use it.

rules.name: The Fixed Pigments Rule
rules.body: Centre sub-identities use indigo, laterite or leaf, applied only to the centre lockup block and the 6px accent bar. A centre never gets a new hue and never repaints the bands.

rules.name: The Stone-Cut Rule
rules.body: Headings are Anek at condensed width (76 to 86 percent), weight 640 to 650, with tight leading. Hindi resets to 100 percent width and line-height 1.3.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Every number in a figure, table or chart uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase type anywhere. Small labels gain at most 0.05em tracking.

rules.name: The Named Steps Rule
rules.body: New text takes a step from the hierarchy above. Fixed sizes between 1.1 and 1.25rem and one-off figure sizes in the current CSS are drift, not steps (see Do's and Don'ts).

rules.name: The Material, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces by changing band material or drawing a hairline. The menu panel's shadow is the single exception.

dos: **Do** alternate full-bleed shade, ground and stone bands, and let the change of material mark each section.
**Do** open every major section with a threshold: hairline, one bay of light, title in bays 1 to 5.
**Do** use the lifted red (noon) as light on shade and the brand red (noon-ink) as light on stone and ground.
**Do** keep the sun-red fill for the single primary action per view, with white text, hovering to sun-deep.
**Do** keep amber for the prototype strip and placeholders only.
**Do** set the official logo reversed on shade at its locked 724:120 ratio: 54px in the masthead (38px at 560px, 34px at 420px), 52px in the footer.
**Do** render every fact with a source line, and every unknown with a visible placeholder that names an owner.
**Do** set headings in Anek at condensed width (76 to 86 percent) and long reading in Martel at 68ch.
**Do** cap registers and fact blocks with a 3px ink rule and divide their rows with 1px rules.
**Do** leave chart bars neutral at rest and light them only on hover or focus.

**Do** run motion on the shared ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), from an already-visible default, keep the focal entrance to once per session, and give every movement a reduced-motion path that keeps only colour and opacity.
**Do** keep focus visible: a 3px noon-ink outline, noon on shade.
**Do** limit centre accents to indigo, laterite and leaf, on the lockup and accent bar only.
donts: **Don't** use the lifted red (noon) as a line or focus ring on stone or ground, or the brand red as a line on shade.
**Don't** use amber for anything that belongs to IIMB rather than to the prototype.
**Don't** stretch, crop, recolour or flex the logo, or rebuild it as type.
**Don't** round corners on buttons, fields, chips, panels or images. Radius belongs only to meta dots, bar-chart ends and focus outlines.
**Don't** add drop shadows or elevation. The open menu panel is the single exception.
**Don't** build grids of same-size cards. Use ruled registers, editorial lead-plus-column story layouts, and banded rows.
**Don't** add a second focal animation, hide text or actions behind an entrance, or animate counters.
**Don't** use decorative gradients, carousels or autoplay.
**Don't** set type in uppercase or add letter-spacing above 0.05em.
**Don't** add new fixed heading sizes between 1.1 and 1.25rem; use title small or item.
**Don't** let pergola beams cross headline text, or put them on the homepage lead or article head.
